get_dropbox_file_link.description: Get a download link that expires after 4 hours

copy_dropbox_file.description: Copy a file to a new path in Dropbox

from_path.label: From Path
from_path.description: Path of the file to copy.

to_path.label: To Path
to_path.description: New path, including the file name.

delete_dropbox_file.label: Delete File
delete_dropbox_file.description: Delete a file; it can be restored from Dropbox

path.label: Path
path.description: File to delete. Dropbox keeps it in deleted files for restore.

list_dropbox_file_revisions.label: List File Revisions
list_dropbox_file_revisions.description: List the stored revisions of a file

path.label: Path
path.description: The file whose revisions to list. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt) or an id (id:abc123).

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Path returns revisions of whatever currently sits at the path; ID follows the same file across moves and renames.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum revisions to return, between 1 and 100.

restore_dropbox_file.label: Restore File Revision
restore_dropbox_file.description: Restore a file to a previous revision

path.label: Path
path.description: The file to restore, as a path such as /folder/file.txt, not an id.

rev.label: Revision
rev.description: The revision to restore the file to. Obtain it from List File Revisions.

lock_dropbox_file.label: Lock File
lock_dropbox_file.description: Temporarily lock a file against edits

path.label: Path
path.description: The file to lock. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt) or an id (id:abc123), but not a rev: value.

unlock_dropbox_file.label: Unlock File
unlock_dropbox_file.description: Release a lock on a file

path.label: Path
path.description: The file to unlock. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt) or an id (id:abc123), but not a rev: value.

get_dropbox_file_lock.label: Get File Lock
get_dropbox_file_lock.description: Check whether a file is locked

path.label: Path
path.description: The file to check. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt) or an id (id:abc123), but not a rev: value.

create_dropbox_upload_link.label: Create Upload Link
create_dropbox_upload_link.description: Create a temporary link for uploading a file

path.label: Destination Path
path.description: Where the uploaded file will be written (e.g. /folder/file.txt). Accepts a path or an id (id:abc123).

mode.label: Write Mode
mode.description: Add keeps any existing file and renames on conflict; Overwrite replaces it.

autorename.label: Auto Rename
autorename.description: Let Dropbox rename the upload if the path conflicts.

duration.label: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: How long the link stays valid, between 60 and 14400 seconds.

get_dropbox_thumbnails_batch.label: Get Thumbnails (Batch)
get_dropbox_thumbnails_batch.description: Get thumbnails for several files at once

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: The image files to thumbnail, at most 25. Each accepts a path (/folder/photo.jpg), an id (id:abc123) or a revision (rev:a1c10ce0dd78). A JSON list.

get_dropbox_thumbnails_batch.beforeRequest:
request.body.entries = request.body.entries.map((path) => ({path: path, format: inputs.format, size: inputs.size}));
return request;

path.label: Destination Path
path.description: Where to save the file, as a path such as /folder/file.pdf, not an id.

url.label: URL
url.description: The publicly reachable URL for Dropbox to download.

get_dropbox_save_url_status.description: Check the status of a Save URL job

async_job_id.description: The job ID from Save URL to Dropbox.

autorename.label: Auto Rename
autorename.description: If the name is taken, save under a new name instead of failing.

from_path.description: Path of the folder to copy.

to_path.label: To Path
to_path.description: New path, including the folder name.

autorename.label: Auto Rename

allow_ownership_transfer.label: Allow Ownership Transfer
allow_ownership_transfer.description: Has no effect on copies; Dropbox applies it to moves only.

to_path.label: To Path

allow_ownership_transfer.label: Allow Ownership Transfer
allow_ownership_transfer.description: Allow the move even if it changes who owns the folder.

delete_dropbox_folder.label: Delete Folder
delete_dropbox_folder.description: Delete a folder and everything in it

path.label: Path
path.description: Folder to delete. Dropbox keeps it in deleted files for restore.

list_dropbox_folder.label: List Folder
list_dropbox_folder.description: List the files and subfolders in a folder

path.label: Path
path.description: Folder to list, starting with /. Use / for the root.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: About how many entries to return. Empty: 2,000.

search_dropbox.label: Search

query.label: Query
query.description: Words to find in file and folder names or contents.

path.label: Path
path.description: Folder to search in. Empty: the whole Dropbox.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum matches to return, up to 1,000. Empty: 100.

filename_only.label: Filename Only
filename_only.description: Match names only, not file contents.

file_categories.label: File Categories
file_categories.description: Comma-separated: image, document, pdf, spreadsheet, presentation, audio, video, folder, paper, others.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Team accounts: only this member's files. Starts with dbid:.

get_dropbox_file_metadata.label: Get File Metadata
get_dropbox_file_metadata.description: Get metadata for a file or folder

path.label: Path
path.description: The file or folder to inspect. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt), an id (id:abc123) or a revision (rev:a1c10ce0dd78).

include_deleted.label: Include Deleted
include_deleted.description: Return metadata for a deleted entry instead of failing when the path no longer exists.

include_media_info.label: Include Media Info
include_media_info.description: Include photo and video metadata when available.

include_has_explicit_shared_members.label: Include Shared Members Flag
include_has_explicit_shared_members.description: Include whether the entry has explicit shared members assigned.

create_dropbox_copy_reference.label: Create Copy Reference
create_dropbox_copy_reference.description: Create a copy reference for a file or folder

path.label: Path
path.description: The file or folder to reference. Accepts a path (/folder/file.txt), an id (id:abc123) or a revision (rev:a1c10ce0dd78).

save_dropbox_copy_reference.label: Save Copy Reference
save_dropbox_copy_reference.description: Save a copy reference into this account

copy_reference.label: Copy Reference
copy_reference.description: The reference string returned by Create Copy Reference.

path.label: Destination Path
path.description: Where to save the entry, as a path such as /folder/file.txt, not an id.

start_dropbox_copy_batch.label: Start Copy Batch
start_dropbox_copy_batch.description: Copy many files or folders in one job

entries.label: Entries
entries.description: Each entry needs a From Path and a To Path. Both accept a path (/folder/file.txt) or an id (id:abc123). At most 1000 entries. A JSON list of {"from_path", "to_path"}.

autorename.label: Auto Rename
autorename.description: Let Dropbox rename an entry when its destination conflicts.

start_dropbox_copy_batch.beforeRequest:
request.body.entries = request.body.entries.map((entry) => ({from_path: entry.from_path, to_path: entry.to_path}));
return request;
